title: Several side quests I picked up (Berin's Coin Road, the Dark Beacon, the Lost Sentry, Two Keepers-One Covenant, Bray's Watch) were simply left behind at game's end with no epilogue line acknowledging them one way or the other, while a couple of similarly-abandoned threads (the oath-stone at Highward) did get a specific closing line — the game is inconsistent about which loose ends it bothers to resolve narratively.
